typographie_suggestion.explanation: The text features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and unbracketed, hairline serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style (similar to Bodoni or Didot), which was prevalent in academic and formal printing during the 19th century.
